📘 How to Use This Material

  1. Read the Quick Shortcuts box before starting a topic — use it in the exam, not long-form calculation.
  2. Click a question to reveal the step-by-step solution — try solving it yourself first.
  3. Wrong answers go into a separate mistake notebook — revisit them weekly.
  4. This document prints cleanly — use your browser's Print to get a PDF with all answers visible.
What's new in this edition: Added 6 chapters from the Pinnacle 6800 MCQ book — Height & Distance, Linear/Circular Races, Instalments, Mean/Median/Mode, Coordinate Geometry and Probability. Every existing topic now has expanded formulas (sphere/cone/hemisphere, triangle centres, polygons, tangents, factor sums, trailing zeros, recurring decimals, componendo-dividendo, late/early speed, discriminant and more) and more question types (Geometry & Trig, Mensuration, Number System, Work, Ratio). Corrected earlier errors: x³−1/x³ = k³+3k and the "leaving remainder" HCF questions.

TOPIC 1

Number System

100 Questions
⚡ Quick Shortcuts
  • Unit digit cycles: 2→(2,4,8,6) 3→(3,9,7,1) 4→(4,6) 7→(7,9,3,1) 8→(8,4,2,6) 9→(9,1); 0,1,5,6 repeat themselves
  • Divisibility by 11: (sum of odd-place digits) − (sum of even-place digits) = 0 or a multiple of 11
  • Divisibility: 4 (last two digits), 8 (last three), 9 (digit sum); 7/11/13 via abcabc = abc × 1001
  • Number of factors of aᵖbᑫ = (p+1)(q+1); sum of factors = (aᵖ⁺¹−1)/(a−1) × (bᑫ⁺¹−1)/(b−1)
  • Sum of first n natural numbers = n(n+1)/2; trailing zeros in n! = ⌊n/5⌋ + ⌊n/25⌋ + …
  • Recurring decimals: 0.ab̄ = ab/99; 0.abc̄ = abc/999; 0.a b̄ = (ab−a)/90
  • Prime test: divide by primes up to √N; Fermat: aᵖ⁻¹ ≡ 1 (mod p)

TOPIC 2

HCF & LCM

100 Questions
⚡ Quick Shortcuts
  • HCF × LCM = product of the two numbers (only for 2 numbers)
  • Largest number dividing x,y leaving remainders a,b → HCF(x−a, y−b) (answer must exceed the remainders)
  • Smallest number divisible by x,y,z leaving remainder r each time → LCM(x,y,z) + r
  • HCF of fractions = HCF(numerators)/LCM(denominators); LCM of fractions = LCM(numerators)/HCF(denominators)
  • Bells/lights ring together again after LCM of the intervals

TOPIC 7

Profit, Loss & Discount

100 Questions
⚡ Quick Shortcuts
  • Profit% = (SP−CP)/CP × 100 ; Loss% = (CP−SP)/CP × 100
  • SP = CP × (100±%)/100
  • Successive discounts a%,b% → net = a+b−ab/100
  • MP relation: SP = MP × (100−Discount%)/100; MP = CP(1+markup%)
  • False weight trick: Gain% = (True weight − False weight)/False weight × 100
  • Same SP, x% gain and x% loss → overall loss = x²/100 %

TOPIC 9

Time and Work

100 Questions
⚡ Quick Shortcuts
  • Work rate = 1/(days to finish); combined rate = sum of individual rates
  • Efficiency is inversely proportional to time taken; total work = LCM of days
  • Man-days rule: M1×D1 = M2×D2
  • Pipes: inlet = +rate, outlet/leak = −rate
  • Wages are divided in proportion to work done
Q1A can finish a work in 26 days and B in 20 days. In how many days will they finish it together?

  • Speed=Distance/Time; km/hr→m/s ×5/18; m/s→km/hr ×18/5

  • Simple partnership (same time invested): profit divided in ratio of capitals
  • Compound partnership (different capital AND time): profit ratio = (capital × time) for each partner
  • If a partner leaves/joins midway, calculate capital×months separately for each period

Boats & Streams

100 Questions
⚡ Quick Shortcuts
  • Downstream speed = boat speed + stream speed (u+v)
  • Upstream speed = boat speed − stream speed (u−v)
  • Boat speed = ½(downstream+upstream); Stream speed = ½(downstream−upstream)
  • Time = Distance/Speed — use downstream speed going with current, upstream against it

  1. Down = 14+7
  2. Up = 14−7
Answer: Downstream=21, Upstream=7 km/hr

  • Linear equation ax+b=c → x = (c−b)/a
  • Quadratic formula: x = [−b ± √(b²−4ac)] / 2a for ax²+bx+c=0
  • Sum of roots = −b/a ; Product of roots = c/a
  • Discriminant D = b²−4ac: D>0 two real roots, D=0 equal roots, D<0 no real roots
  • Factorization method is faster than the formula when roots are whole numbers

⚡ Quick Shortcuts
  • Distance = √[(x₂−x₁)² + (y₂−y₁)²]; Midpoint = ((x₁+x₂)/2, (y₁+y₂)/2)
  • Section (m:n): ((mx₂+nx₁)/(m+n), (my₂+ny₁)/(m+n)); Centroid = mean of vertices

⚡ Quick Shortcuts
  • P(E) = favourable/total; 0 ≤ P(E) ≤ 1; P(not E) = 1 − P(E)
  • P(A∪B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A∩B); independent: P(A∩B) = P(A)·P(B)
  • Two dice: 36 outcomes; pack: 52 cards (26 red, 12 face, 4 of each rank)
  • Without replacement: multiply successive reduced fractions
